finalists.label: Cutaneous T-cell lymphoma
finalists.why: Strong evidence from skin biopsy and immunohistochemical staining showing monomorphic, perivascular, and periadnexal atypical lymphocytic infiltrate and CD3-positive T cells coexpressing CD4 and CD8 with preserved expression of CD7.

finalists.label: Lymphoma
finalists.why: Similar evidence to Cutaneous T-cell lymphoma, with skin biopsy and immunohistochemical staining showing monomorphic, perivascular, and periadnexal atypical lymphocytic infiltrate and CD3-positive T cells coexpressing CD4 and CD8 with preserved expression of CD7.

frontier_selector.why: The champion is chosen because it is a subtype of Lymphoma and the vignette actually establishes it with specific findings such as CD3-positive T cells coexpressing CD4 and CD8 with preserved expression of CD7.
